不同观点：
• [brahma-dev] 认为军事大国在战争失败后应保持低调，但现实并非如此。该评论提到某国在三年中本应三天结束的战争却持续至今，并批评该国在推特上就轰炸、停火、驱逐墨西哥劳工和南非富豪等问题上反复发言。这暗示对某些国家外交政策和军事行动的不满。

• [OgsyedIE] 关注IAEA的独立性和潜在的以色列间谍渗透问题，询问是否有证据支持这一说法，并探讨是否有可能由独立方设立替代IAEA的机构。这反映了对国际组织公正性和透明度的担忧。

• [magic_hamster] 认为伊朗与IAEA的合作只是表面文章，西方国家无论如何都会依赖间谍活动来评估伊朗的核活动。评论指出，伊朗的铀浓缩水平远超和平用途所需，且其发展导弹和核弹头研发能力显而易见。评论还提到，伊朗的行为类似于电影《火星人攻击》中的外星人，表面宣称和平却暗中准备攻击，暗示对伊朗意图的不信任。

strikes on its nuclear enrichment facilities

data.title: The Past Is a Ghost and the Future a Fantasy
data.author: dnetesn
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了记忆的不可靠性以及人类对过去和未来的重构能力。作者通过自己对童年宠物的记忆错误，说明记忆并非对事实的简单检索，而是一种重建过程，会受到情感和想象的影响。科学表明，大脑通过记忆预测未来，而非仅仅记录过去。我们通过故事构建自我身份，这些故事不仅基于实际发生的事，还包含我们希望发生的事。尽管过去和未来都是大脑的创造，但只有当下时刻是真实的。文章最后引用古代智慧，强调活在当下的重要性。

主要讨论点：如何看待和处理过去的事情

不同观点：
• **lwerdna的观点**：过去像幽灵一样，常常被我们根据当前的需求和自我叙述进行重写。他引用了短篇小说《Truth of Fact, Truth of Feeling》来支持自己的观点，认为人们会为了符合当前的自我认知而修改对过去的记忆。

For years, I told the story of the dalmatian we had when I was a kid. A beautiful white dog with black spots, full of energy, tearing through the backyard, digging up the garden with a kind of reckless joy. That’s why we had to give him away. The dog just wouldn’t stop digging. It became one of those quick, emotional stories I carried with me—a flash of childhood, a symbol of something fleeting and unfinished.
And then one day I brought it up with my dad. He looked at me and said, “It wasn’t a dalmatian. It was a spaniel.”
I was stunned. I didn’t just remember that dog—I
knew
that dog. I could see him in my mind as clearly as if he’d been there yesterday. But apparently, the dalmatian I remembered never existed. I had invented him—half from feeling, half from imagination—and carried that image for decades.

Join now
.
If a memory so vivid could be wrong, what else had I rewritten without even realizing? What else had I turned into a story without knowing it?
The act of remembering is not a retrieval but a recreation.
We have been taught the past is fixed—a record of what has happened. The future, uncertain and unknown, is the territory of possibility. And yet, what science and philosophy are revealing, with an intimacy and precision our ancestors could only dream of, is that both the past and the future are creations of the mind. Only the present, fleeting and indivisible, is objective. All else is artifice.
There is something deeply moving about this revelation. It does not diminish our humanity—it illuminates it.
ADVERTISEMENT

Log in
or
Join now
.
Memory, we now know, is not a storage bin of facts and figures, but the beating, breathing phenomenon of recollection. Each time we remember, we do not pull out a file from the cabinet of the brain.
We
reconstruct
the past
. We infer, we embellish, we forget. The act of remembering is not a retrieval but a recreation. The brain opens the memory like a manuscript, edits the text—sometimes subtly, sometimes wildly—and binds it again, unaware that it has revised history.
And why does the brain do this? Because it is not designed for truth—it is designed for survival.
To remember is to prepare
: to use the past, not to dwell on it, but to anticipate what may come. Memory is not the faculty of historians—it is the engine of prediction.
This is not merely a neurological trick. It is the structure of our lives.
We tell stories about ourselves
, about where we have been, and these stories, repeated and reshaped, become the tapestry of identity. But that tapestry is stitched not only with threads of what happened—but with what we
need
to have happened. With what we
believe
we must have been to justify who we are.
Now look forward.
The future
, too, is imagined—yet no less vivid. The same architecture of the brain that recalls the past also constructs possible futures. The hippocampus, the prefrontal cortex, the default mode network—all flicker to life when we anticipate. And what they create is not prophecy. It is
simulation
. We imagine a dinner party next week or a child we may have one day or the legacy we hope to leave. But these are dreams, no more real than the myths of Homer—crafted from the raw material of memory and desire.
ADVERTISEMENT

or
Join now
.
We humans are time-binders, as Polish philosopher Alfred Korzybski called us. But we bind time not as it is—but as we wish it to be.
This dual invention—of past and future—places us on a tightrope above the infinite. It is only the present, the moment of being, that is ever truly real. But how brief that moment is.
Neuroscientist David Eagleman
has told us that even our perception of the present is slightly delayed. Our senses arrive not all at once but in sequence. The brain waits—perhaps a tenth of a second—to gather the full picture before announcing: “This is now.”
Time is not a track we move along. It is a field we cultivate.
And yet it is that small “now” in which all reality resides. It is in the present that we touch, that we breathe, that we think. It is in the present that a child laughs, that a truth is spoken, that an idea is born. The past is gone. The future is not yet. But the present—the only time we can act—is ours.

It is astonishing that this insight, as modern as quantum physics, is also as ancient as the Upanishads. “Yesterday is but a dream,” the Sanskrit poets wrote, “and tomorrow is only a vision. But today well-lived makes every yesterday a dream of happiness and every tomorrow a vision of hope.”

data.title: Air pollution linked to lung cancer-driving DNA mutations, study finds
data.author: jmsflknr
data.article_summary: 一项研究发现，空气污染与肺癌相关的DNA突变有关，尤其在东亚地区，空气污染导致腺癌的比例最高。研究分析了全球871名从不吸烟的肺癌患者的肿瘤基因，发现空气污染越严重，肿瘤中的致癌突变越多，特别是TP53基因的突变。此外，污染还与染色体末端保护性DNA链（端粒）的过早缩短有关，这与细胞快速分裂相关，是癌症的标志。随着全球吸烟率下降，从不吸烟的肺癌患者比例上升，空气污染成为日益严重的全球问题。英国每年因此确诊超过1100例肺癌，而中国等东亚国家问题尤为严重。

Photograph: Tingshu Wang/Reuters
View image in fullscreen
Smog in Beijing. Recent research found that the highest rates of adenocarcinoma attributable to air pollution were in east Asia.

Cancer research
Air pollution linked to lung cancer-driving DNA mutations, study finds
Research finds that the higher the levels of air pollution in a region, the more cancer-promoting mutations are present
Ian Sample
Science editor
Wed 2 Jul 2025 11.00 EDT
Last modified on Wed 2 Jul 2025 12.30 EDT
Share
Air pollution has been linked to a swathe of lung cancer-driving DNA mutations, in a study of people diagnosed with the disease despite never having smoked tobacco.
The findings from an investigation into cancer patients around the world helps explain why those who have never smoked make up a
rising proportion
of people developing the cancer, a trend the researchers called an “urgent and growing global problem”.
Prof Ludmil Alexandrov, a senior author on the study at the University of California in San Diego, said researchers had observed the “problematic trend” but had not understood the cause.
“Our research shows that air pollution is strongly associated with the same types of DNA mutations we typically associate with smoking,” he said.
The scientists analysed the entire genetic code of lung tumours removed from 871 never-smokers in Europe, North America, Africa and Asia as part of the
Sherlock-Lung study
. They found that the higher the levels of air pollution in a region, the more cancer-driving and cancer-promoting mutations were present in residents’ tumours.
Fine-particulate air pollution was in particular linked to mutations in the TP53 gene. These have previously been associated with tobacco smoking.
People exposed to greater air pollution also had shorter telomeres, protective strands of DNA found at the ends of chromosomes, which are often compared with the caps on shoelaces. Premature shortening of telomeres is a sign of more rapid cell division, a hallmark of cancer.
“This is an urgent and growing global problem that we are working to understand,” said Dr Maria Teresa Landi, an epidemiologist on the study at the US National
Cancer
Institute in Maryland.
With smoking in decline in many parts of the world, including the UK and the US, people who have never smoked are making up a larger proportion of lung cancer patients. Current estimates suggest that 10-25% of lung cancers are now diagnosed in this group. Almost all such cancers are a form known as adenocarcinoma.
Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. About 2.5m new cases are diagnosed globally each year. More than a million of the deaths occur in China, where smoking, air pollution and other environmental contaminants are factors.
Recent
research
found that the highest rates of adenocarcinoma attributable to air pollution were in east Asia. While cases in the UK were much lower, they still amounted to more than 1,100 new diagnoses a year, scientists found.
The latest work,
published in Nature
, identified only a slight rise in cancer-causing mutations in people exposed to secondhand tobacco smoke.
But the study highlighted a significant risk from certain Chinese herbal medicines that contain aristolochic acid. Signature mutations linked to the herbal medicines were seen almost exclusively in never-smokers from Taiwan.
Another mysterious mutational signature was seen in people who had never smoked but not those who did, and was now the focus of “intense investigation”, Landi said.

data.title: Confidence in agentic AI: Why eval infrastructure must come first
data.author: amirkabbara
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了AI代理在实际应用中的部署及其带来的挑战和机遇。技术领袖们在VentureBeat的Transform 2025会议上分享了他们的经验。AI代理不仅节省人力成本，还能显著提升业务转化率，如Rocket Companies通过代理将网站转化率提高了三倍，并节省了百万小时的人工时间。这些代理能自动化特定任务，如计算抵押贷款税费，从而大幅降低成本。然而，构建和扩展AI代理面临复杂性，包括模型选择、响应性保障及数据整合等问题。随着代理数量增加，路由和延迟成为技术难题。目前，企业需结合内部开发和外部供应商合作，以优化AI代理的性能和维护。未来，AI代理将进一步推动业务效率和创新。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI代理在实际应用中的实施挑战，包括定义其定位、有效构建以及规模化操作。

不同观点：
• 一方认为员工没有全面考虑AI代理的多个关键实施方面，如规模化准备和定位定义，这可能对项目和组织造成不利影响。例子中提到的员工只是完成了新功能，但没有解决更广泛的战略问题，这可能导致产品在实际应用中出现问题。因此，有人认为应该对这样的员工采取严厉措施，甚至解雇。

• 另一方则可能认为员工完成了新功能开发，这在短期内是有具体成果的。他们可能认为构建和规模化操作是后续阶段可以逐步解决的问题，而不应该作为解雇员工的理由。有人可能会主张给予员工更多的指导和培训，以帮助他们提高在AI项目中综合考虑各种因素的能力。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于员工的责任范围以及未完成的任务对整体项目的实际影响。一方关注的是战略和长远影响，另一方则关注短期成果和员工的潜在成长空间。

• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是组织对AI代理部署的准备程度。如果组织本身缺乏明确的战略和支持机制，那么将所有责任归于员工可能是不公平的。

• 还有人可能提到沟通和期望管理的重要性。如果在项目开始时没有明确传达对规模化和定位的要求，那么员工未能完成这些任务可能是因为不清楚预期。

As AI agents enter real-world deployment, organizations are under pressure to define where they belong, how to build them effectively, and how to operationalize them at scale. At VentureBeat’s
Transform 2025
, tech leaders gathered to talk about how they’re transforming their business with agents: Joanne Chen, general partner at Foundation Capital; Shailesh Nalawadi, VP of project management with Sendbird; Thys Waanders, SVP of AI transformation at Cognigy; and Shawn Malhotra, CTO, Rocket Companies.
A few top agentic AI use cases
“The initial attraction of any of these deployments for AI agents tends to be around saving human capital — the math is pretty straightforward,” Nalawadi said. “However, that undersells the transformational capability you get with AI agents.”
At Rocket, AI agents have proven to be powerful tools in increasing website conversion.
“We’ve found that with our agent-based experience, the conversational experience on the website, clients are three times more likely to convert when they come through that channel,” Malhotra said.
But that’s just scratching the surface. For instance, a Rocket engineer built an agent in just two days to automate a highly specialized task: calculating transfer taxes during mortgage underwriting.
“That two days of effort saved us a million dollars a year in expense,” Malhotra said. “In 2024, we saved more than a million team member hours, mostly off the back of our AI solutions. That’s not just saving expense. It’s also allowing our team members to focus their time on people making what is often the largest financial transaction of their life.”
Agents are essentially supercharging individual team members. That million hours saved isn’t the entirety of someone’s job replicated many times. It’s fractions of the job that are things employees don’t enjoy doing, or weren’t adding value to the client. And that million hours saved gives Rocket the capacity to handle more business.
“Some of our team members were able to handle 50% more clients last year than they were the year before,” Malhotra added. “It means we can have higher throughput, drive more business, and again, we see higher conversion rates because they’re spending the time understanding the client’s needs versus doing a lot of more rote work that the AI can do now.”
Tackling agent complexity
“Part of the journey for our engineering teams is moving from the mindset of software engineering – write once and test it and it runs and gives the same answer 1,000 times – to the more probabilistic approach, where you ask the same thing of an LLM and it gives different answers through some probability,” Nalawadi said. “A lot of it has been bringing people along. Not just software engineers, but product managers and UX designers.”
What’s helped is that LLMs have come a long way, Waanders said. If they built something 18 months or two years ago, they really had to pick the right model, or the agent would not perform as expected. Now, he says, we’re now at a stage where most of the mainstream models behave very well. They’re more predictable. But today the challenge is combining models, ensuring responsiveness, orchestrating the right models in the right sequence and weaving in the right data.
“We have customers that push tens of millions of conversations per year,” Waanders said. “If you automate, say, 30 million conversations in a year, how does that scale in the LLM world? That’s all stuff that we had to discover, simple stuff, from even getting the model availability with the cloud providers. Having enough quota with a ChatGPT model, for example. Those are all learnings that we had to go through, and our customers as well. It’s a brand-new world.”
A layer above orchestrating the LLM is orchestrating a network of agents, Malhotra said. A conversational experience has a network of agents under the hood, and the orchestrator is deciding which agent to farm the request out to from those available.
“If you play that forward and think about having hundreds or thousands of agents who are capable of different things, you get some really interesting technical problems,” he said. “It’s becoming a bigger problem, because latency and time matter. That agent routing is going to be a very interesting problem to solve over the coming years.”
Tapping into vendor relationships
Up to this point, the first step for most companies launching agentic AI has been building in-house, because specialized tools didn’t yet exist. But you can’t differentiate and create value by building generic LLM infrastructure or AI infrastructure, and you need specialized expertise to go beyond the initial build, and debug, iterate, and improve on what’s been built, as well as maintain the infrastructure.

data.title: Ask HN: Are AI Copilots Eroding Our Programming Skills?
data.author: buscoideais
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI编程助手的价值与局限

不同观点：
• MongooseStudios认为当前的AI编程助手没有实际价值。他们指出，这些工具生成的代码缺乏个性，而且生成的日志信息与个人风格不符。他们强调，手动完成一些基础性工作可以帮助开发者更好地理解和解决问题，而AI助手没有这种能力。此外，他们担心AI助手可能会生成错误的代码或虚构信息，且无法从错误中学习。

• KaranSohi持相对积极的观点，认为AI编程助手是有帮助的，特别是在快速生成代码和减轻工作负担方面。KaranSohi提到，只要开发者对生成的代码进行审查，这些工具可以作为有效的辅助手段。同时，他们也提到选择合适的工具是一个挑战，因为市场上有多种选择和频繁的更新。

• NewUser76312提供了一个类比，将AI编程助手与计算器和心算技能进行比较。他们认为，虽然过度依赖AI助手可能会导致编程技能的退化，但只要开发者继续亲自编写代码，就不会完全丧失编程能力。他们同时指出，使用AI助手可以提高效率，但开发者需要在使用过程中保持技能的练习。

补充讨论：
• MongooseStudios特别提到AI助手生成的代码缺乏个性化，且无法回忆和解释代码构建的原因，这与人类开发者不同。
• KaranSohi关注工具选择的困难，指出市场上的多种工具和频繁更新增加了开发者的负担。
• NewUser76312通过计算器的类比，提出平衡使用AI助手和保持编程技能的观点，认为两者可以共存而不必然导致技能退化。

争议焦点：
• 当前AI编程助手的实际价值和可靠性。MongooseStudios对其持怀疑态度，而KaranSohi和NewUser76312则认为在适当使用和审查的情况下，这些工具是有帮助的。
• 使用AI编程助手是否会导致编程技能的退化。NewUser76312认为不会，而MongooseStudios则担心过度依赖可能导致技能减弱。

data.title: Genetic code enables zebrafish to mend damaged organs
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: 新研究由加州理工学院和加州大学伯克利分校的科学家合作完成，发现斑马鱼心脏再生能力由神经嵴细胞控制。这些细胞在心脏受损时启动特定基因电路，促进心脏组织再生。当这些细胞被移除后，斑马鱼心脏失去再生能力。研究还表明，这些基因在胚胎发育中活跃，成年后休眠，再生时重新激活。研究团队正使用CRISPR技术探索是否能在人类心肌细胞中重新激活这些基因，以期修复人类心脏损伤。研究成果发表于《美国国家科学院院刊》。

主要讨论点：关于蜥蜴再生尾部能力的遗传机制，以及为什么人类未进化出类似能力

不同观点：

• m3kw9：质疑为什么人类在进化过程中没有获得类似的再生能力，暗示这种能力在自然选择中可能未被优先考虑。
• sydbarrett74：用“ nocturnal bottleneck ”来解释，可能指的是进化过程中某些环境或生态限制导致某些能力（如再生能力）未在人类中发展。

Genetic Code Enables Zebrafish to Mend Damaged Organs
Genetic Code Enables Zebrafish to Mend Damaged Organs
June 23, 2025
Zebrafish have the remarkable and rare ability to regrow and repair their hearts after damage. New research from Caltech and UC Berkeley has identified the circuit of genes controlling this ability and offers clues about how a human heart might someday be repaired after damage, such as a heart attack or in cases of congenital heart defects.
The research was a collaboration between the laboratories of
Marianne Bronner
, Caltech's Edward B. Lewis Professor of Biology and director of the Beckman Institute, and developmental biologist Megan Martik of UC Berkeley. A paper describing the study appears in the journal
Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
.
The heart is made up of many different kinds of cells, such as muscle, nerve, and blood vessel cells. In zebrafish, around 12 to 15 percent of these cells originate from a specific population of stem cells called neural crest cells. The Bronner and Martik laboratories have studied neural crest cells and their crucial role in development in many lab animal models, including zebrafish and lamprey. Humans also have analogous neural crest cells that give rise to varied cell types in almost every organ of the body ranging from cells of the facial skeleton to cells of the nervous system.
In the new study, the team found that the heart cells derived from neural crest cells are responsible for orchestrating the reconstruction process in damaged zebrafish hearts. When those neural crest–derived heart cells were removed in experiments, the hearts lost their ability to regenerate after damage. Importantly, the study identified the complex circuit of genes that is activated during regeneration. These genes, the researchers found, are crucial for normal embryonic development and then are inactivated during the animal's adult life—but are reactivated to enable tissue regeneration.
Next, the team aims to study how these cells reactivate such gene programs to answer the question: What signal triggers the activation of these genes after damage? Ultimately, the work could reveal whether humans could activate analogous genes if given that same signal. The Martik team is currently using CRISPR technology—a common gene-editing technique—on human heart cells in lab dishes to determine if these genes can be reactivated.
The paper is titled
"Reactivation of an Embryonic Cardiac Neural Crest Transcriptional Profile During Zebrafish Heart Regeneration."
The first authors are Rekha M. Dhillon-Richardson and Alexandra K. Haugan of UC Berkeley. In addition to Bronner and Martik, additional co-authors are Luke W. Lyons and Joseph K. McKenna of UC Berkeley. Funding was provided by the American Heart Association, the Shurl and Kay Curci Foundation, the National Institutes of Health, and the National Science Foundation. Bronner is an affiliated faculty member with the
Tianqiao and Chrissy Chen Institute for Neuroscience at Caltech
.

data.author: dotcoma
data.article_summary: 《乡村医院关闭的惊人原因》一文探讨了美国乡村医院，尤其是托马斯维尔地区医疗中心关闭的背后原因。尽管该医院于2020年开业，配备了先进设备，但在2024年9月被迫关闭。文章指出，过去十年中，已有超过100家乡村医院关闭，还有三分之一的乡村医院面临关闭风险。托马斯维尔的医院主要依赖私人保险公司支付患者费用，但这些保险公司的报销金额仅为服务成本的一半，导致医院亏损。与城市医院不同，乡村医院无法通过其他途径弥补损失。此外，阿拉巴马州由蓝十字蓝盾保险公司主导市场，医院在谈判中处于劣势，进一步加剧了财务困境。总体而言，私人保险公司的低报销率是乡村医院关闭的主要原因。

THOMASVILLE, ALA.—Thomasville Regional Medical Center was supposed to be a gamechanger. Situated in the U.S. Congressional district with the worst health outcomes in the country, the hospital opened in 2020 with state-of-the art equipment, including a 3D mammogram and an MRI scanner. But it closed less than five years later in Sept. 2024.
Advertisement
Advertisement
The hospital now stands empty: its pristine hallways dark, its expensive machines gathering dust. “It’s almost like the apocalypse happened,” says Sheldon Day, the mayor of Thomasville, who had worked for almost a decade to get a hospital to open there.
This apocalypse is happening throughout rural communities across the country.
More than 100 rural hospitals
have closed in the past decade, according to the Center for Healthcare Quality and Payment Reform (CHQPR), a national policy center that works to improve health care payment systems and whose data have been cited by the
Bipartisan Policy Center
. About one-third of all rural hospitals in the country are at risk of closing because of financial problems. In Alabama, 23 rural hospitals—about half of all of them in the state—are at immediate risk of closing, according to CHQPR.
Advertisement
Even more rural hospitals might be in trouble if Congress passes the huge piece of legislation before it, called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which includes significant cuts that would slash Medicaid spending in rural areas by $119 billion over 10 years,
according to KFF
. Thom Tillis, the U.S. Senator from North Carolina who said he couldn’t support the bill in its current form, said in a
statement
on June 28 that Congress needed to achieve the tax cuts and spending in the bill “without hurting our rural communities and hospitals.”
Why rural hospitals are closing
People often blame rural hospital closures on poor reimbursement rates from Medicare and Medicaid. There’s a reason for that assumption: Just about every hospital loses money on Medicaid and Medicare, since reimbursement rates are low nationwide. But hospitals like the one in Thomasville are struggling not because they serve a large share of poor patients or elderly people on these plans.
Advertisement
“When you look at the data, what you see is that Medicare and Medicaid are not the problem,” says Harold Miller, president and CEO of CHQPR. “The problem is private insurers.”
Rural hospitals depend on private insurers for the majority of their patient costs, Miller says. In Alabama, for instance,
CHQPR’s data
shows that most rural hospitals depend on private insurers for anywhere between 65-80% of patient costs; in Thomasville, 18.4% of patients were using Medicare to pay for their coverage, 16.2% were using Medicaid, and 65.4% were using private insurance.
The exterior of the Thomasville Regional Medical Center, which opened in 2020 and closed in 2024
Thomasville Regional Medical Center
But many rural hospitals are losing money on what private insurers will pay for patient care. The one in Thomasville, for instance, was getting paid by private insurers roughly half of what it was costing to deliver services, according to
federal data compiled by CHQPR
.
Advertisement
This is a very different situation than what is happening between private insurers and urban hospitals, he says. Urban hospitals and large rural hospitals are able to make up for the losses from Medicare and Medicaid patients with what they can charge private insurers. Small rural hospitals can’t do that.
Rural hospitals actually need higher compensation than urban hospitals, Miller says, because they have the same fixed costs like 24-hour staffing, but have a lower volume of patients to cover those costs.
Why small rural hospitals get less from private insurers
One reason why small hospitals get less money: Insurers demand discounts. Larger hospitals have more leverage to negotiate with private insurers over those discounts because they have higher patient volumes. Smaller hospitals have less wiggle room to negotiate.
Another problem in Alabama in particular is that just one health insurer, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Alabama, has an
estimated 94%
of the large-group private insurance market, which most people with private health insurance fall under. Hospitals can’t negotiate as well because they have to accept Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Alabama patients,

不同观点：
• [yndoendo] 提问Intel的高端芯片目前是否仍由台积电（TSMC）生产，还是已经回到Intel自家工厂生产。这表明对Intel近期生产策略变化的关注，尤其是是否继续依赖外部代工。

• [ksec] 引用消息来源指出，在新的CEO Lip-Bu Tan上任后，Intel正在快速调整策略以削减成本和寻找新的复兴路径。特别提到18A制造工艺逐渐失去对新客户的吸引力，并暗示公司董事会可能会再次成为关键决策者。这表明对Intel内部策略变化及其未来方向的质疑。

补充讨论：
• [ksec] 提到前CEO Pat Gelsinger曾大力推行的18A工艺，如今在现任CEO领导下可能被放弃，显示出公司内部策略的转变。

• 另一个值得注意的点是公司董事会在此决策过程中的角色，显示出对高层决策机制的关注。

总结来看，评论主要围绕Intel的生产策略调整，特别是是否继续使用台积电代工以及内部18A工艺的未来方向，同时对公司高层的决策能力和策略提出了质疑。

Embabel Agent Framework
Embabel (Em-BAY-bel) is a framework for authoring agentic flows on the JVM that seamlessly mix LLM-prompted interactions
with code and domain models. Supports
intelligent path finding towards goals. Written in Kotlin
but offers a natural usage
model from Java.
From the creator of Spring.
Key Concepts
Models agentic flows in terms of:
Actions
: Steps an agent takes
Goals
: What an agent is trying to achieve
Conditions
: Conditions to assess before executing an action or determining that a goal has been achieved.
Conditions are reassessed after each action is executed.
Domain model
: Objects underpinning the flow and informing Actions, Goals and Conditions.
Plan
: A sequence of actions to achieve a goal. Plans are dynamically formulated by the system, not the programmer.
The
system replans after the completion of each action, allowing it to adapt to new information as well as observe the
effects of the previous action.
This is effectively an
OODA loop
.
Application developers don't usually have to deal with these concepts directly,
as most conditions result from data flow defined in code, allowing the system to infer
pre and post conditions.
These concepts underpin these differentiators versus other agent frameworks:
Sophisticated planning.
Goes beyond a finite state machine or sequential execution
with nesting by introducing a true planning step, using a
non-LLM AI algorithm. This enables the system to perform tasks it wasn’t programmed to do by combining known
steps in
a novel order, as well as make decisions about parallelization and other runtime behavior.
Superior extensibility and reuse
: Because of dynamic planning, adding more domain objects, actions, goals and
conditions
can extend the capability of the system,
without editing FSM definitions
or existing code.
Strong typing and the benefits of object orientation
: Actions, goals and conditions are informed by a domain
model, which can
include behavior. Everything is strongly typed and prompts and
manually authored code interact cleanly. No more magic maps. Enjoy full refactoring support.
Other benefits:
Platform abstraction
: Clean separation between programming model and platform internals allows running locally
while
potentially offering higher QoS in production without changing application code.
Designed for LLM mixing
: It is easy to build applications that mix LLMs, ensuring the most cost-effective yet
capable solution.
This enables the system to leverage the strengths of different models for different tasks. In particular, it
facilitates
the use of local models for point tasks. This can be important for cost and privacy.
Built on Spring and the JVM,
making it easy to access existing enterprise functionality and capabilities.
For example:
Spring can inject and manage agents, including using Spring AOP to decorate functions.
Robust persistence and transaction management solutions are available.
Designed for testability
from the ground up. Both unit testing and agent end to end testing are easy.
Flows can be authored in one of two ways:
An annotation-based model similar to Spring MVC, with types annotated with the Spring stereotype
@Agent
, using
@Goal
,
@Condition
and
@Action
methods.
Idiomatic Kotlin DSL with
agent {
and
action {
blocks.
Either way, flows are backed by a domain model of objects that can have rich behavior.
We are working toward allowing natural language actions and goals to be deployed.
The planning step is pluggable.
The default planning approach is
Goal Oriented Action Planning
.
GOAP is a popular AI planning algorithm used in gaming. It allows for dynamic decision-making and action selection based
on the current state of the world and the goals of the agent.
Goals, actions and plans are independent of GOAP. Future planning options include:
Plans created by a reasoning model

data.title: The original LZEXE (A.K.A. Kosinski) compressor source code has been released
data.author: elvis70
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了LZEXE压缩格式（也称为Kosinski）的历史及其源代码的发现。作者提到，LZEXE曾用于20世纪80年代末和90年代压缩DOS可执行文件，其开发者Fabrice Bellard发布了1990年以来的源代码，采用MIT许可。该代码用x86汇编编写压缩逻辑，前端则用Pascal编写，可能是v0.91版本。作者之前开发的Kosinski压缩器无法准确再现Mega CD BIOS中的压缩数据，怀疑是使用了不同版本或有不同bug的压缩工具。尽管现在有了Kosinski和Saxman的源代码，但Enigma和Nemesis格式的压缩器可能仍是Sega专有，难以找到。作者还回应了关于修改WonderMega BIOS中压缩数据遇到的困难。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对软件压缩算法及其历史影响的讨论

不同观点：
• [johndoe0815] 强调了Fabrice Bellard在软件开发领域的贡献，指出他是多款知名软件（如qemu, tinyemu, tcc, ffmpeg等）的原作者，并提供了其个人网站链接以供参考。
• [userbinator] 补充了关于PC BIOS使用LZ系列压缩算法的历史，特别提到LZSS及其相关衍生算法（如Deflate/Zlib, ZIP等），并指出Phoenix公司曾对此拥有专利。
• [hannob] 回忆了90年代可执行文件（exe/com）压缩和保护工具的场景，描述了当时压缩工具除了减小文件大小外，还被用于防止修改和反调试保护。他也提到自己曾编写检测工具并管理相关的邮件列表。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：虽然没有直接的争议，但[hannob]的评论暗示了当时压缩工具被用于反调试等技术保护措施，可能引发对技术使用正当性的讨论。

44426864.article_content:
Last year
, I discovered that the Kosinski compression format is actually LZEXE, which was used for compressing DOS executables back in the 90s and the late 80s. Its developer catalogues three versions on
his website
: v0.90, v0.91, and v0.91e. While only binaries of v0.91 and v0.91e can be found on the website, v0.90 can be found mirrored on various
other websites
.
I got in touch with LZEXE’s developer, Fabrice Bellard, and he was able to release
LZEXE’s source code
, untouched since 1990! It is released under the terms of the MIT licence, allowing it to be freely used in other projects. To maximise performance, the compression logic was written in x86 assembly, while its frontend was written in Pascal. This particular source code appears to be for v0.91.
Back in 2021, I made
my own Kosinski compressor
which produced identical data to what could be found in the Mega Drive Sonic games. At the time, I noticed that it did not accurately reproduce the Mega CD BIOS’s compressed Sub-CPU payload data. The inaccuracies were so extensive that it appeared that the BIOS’s data was compressed with a different tool to the Sonic games. Notably, the compressor which was used for the Sonic games suffered from a number of bugs and shortcomings, causing the compressed data to less efficient than it should have been. The Mega CD BIOS developers may have used a different version of the compressor, which lacked these bugs, or which had additional bugs.
With this in mind, the source code which has been released may not be for the exact compressor which was used by the Sonic games, though it could be modified to function identically to it. Since the compression logic was written in assembly, it should be simple enough to disassemble the compressor executables and compare them to the source code. Devon did the heavy-lifting of extracting and unpacking the core logic, which
can be found here
.
With that, we now have the source code of two of the four ‘KENS’ format compressors – Kosinski
and Saxman
! Unfortunately, I do not have much hope of ever finding the original compressors for, let alone the source code of, the remaining two formats –
Enigma
and
Nemesis
– due to them evidently being custom formats which were designed specifically for the Mega Drive, likely meaning that the compressors and their source code never left the hands of Sega (Enigma encodes plane map data, operating on 16-bit words and specifically acknowledging the separation of bits of the tile’s index from its X/Y flip, palette line, and priority; meanwhile Nemesis encodes tiles, operating on nibbles and bunching data into groups of 32 bytes (8 x 8 4-bit nibbles).

data.title: ASCIIMoon: The moon's phase live in ASCII art
data.author: zayat
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个通过ASCII艺术展示月亮每日相位的工具。用户可以通过选择日期查看当天月亮的相位，并在不同日期之间切换。页面展示了用ASCII字符绘制的月亮图像，并提供了“前一天”、“今天”和“后一天”的按钮以便浏览不同日期的月亮相位。此外，页面还显示了所选日期的月相信息和月光强度。整个工具以文本形式呈现月亮的变化。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：ASCII Moon项目的效果、准确性及技术实现

不同观点：
• **SlowTao**：赞赏ASCII艺术，但指出月相显示不准确，半月的明暗部分应精确分割，而不是简单的圆形遮挡。提到GTA San Andreas也有类似问题，但因当时技术限制可以理解。建议调整阴影以提升准确性。
• **thot_experiment**：认为ASCII艺术在大小和颜色变化上失去了一些传统魅力，特别是当尺寸过大或颜色频繁变化时，显得不够纯粹。
• **_aavaa_**：认为使用位图作为遮罩来实现圆形和阴影效果是一种取巧的做法，不够纯粹。
• **shagie**：引用项目关于页面的说明，指出当前的月相显示不符合预期，并提到需要更多的数学计算来精确显示月相的照明百分比，尽管这是一个个人项目。
• **p1mrx**：认为当前的阴影效果看起来物理上不可能，除非是月食，但对没有在阴影中加入星星给予部分肯定。

补充讨论：
• **tingletech**：提到自己曾用JavaScript和SVG制作过月相，并分享了GitHub链接，认为这是其最受欢迎的项目。
• **Nition**：赞赏项目外观，但指出半月形状不准确，并建议根据用户位置调整月相显示方向，以适应南北半球的视觉差异。
• **jpecar**：回忆起类似项目ACME phoon，并分享了链接。
• **spicybright**：指出CSS动画在显示新月和残月切换时显得不够平滑。
• **burnt-resistor**：认为项目有不错的开始，但整体感觉不够准确，建议逐步改进。
• **layer8**：指出在桌面浏览器上放大时，ASCII部分和剪裁圆的匹配会出问题，并讨论了字符分辨率对ASCII艺术的影响。
• **adzm**：希望项目能加入月球天平动和动画功能，以便观察月相变化。
• **D___R___**：回忆起童年在天文馆购买月球土地的经历，认为该项目带有类似的怀旧 charm。
• **divbzero**：质疑ASCII月亮的底部边缘为何是黑色新月，询问这是渲染问题还是真实天文现象。
• **dandrino_**：指出半月不应看起来像被咬了一口，应调整显示效果。

争议焦点：

data.title: Law360 mandates reporters use AI "bias" detection on all stories
data.author: 12_throw_away
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI工具和媒体报道中的偏见问题，以及新闻报道的中立性与偏见之间的平衡

不同观点：
• JoshTriplett认为，媒体不应仅仅引用不同观点而不去探究真相，并指出如果AI工具认为某个标题有偏见，那么这可能正是报道的意图，而非问题。
• jerf以一种讽刺的方式描述了当今事件报道的模糊性和表面化，暗示报道往往缺乏明确的立场和深度分析。
• owisd指出，过度试图中立报道双方观点实际上也是一种偏见，因为它偏袒了更能 convincingly 说谎的一方。
• jauntywundrkind强烈批评所谓的“偏见指示器”，认为它实际上是在攻击理性和报道，并认为这种做法是在迎合那些“哭闹的霸凌者”，最终损害公共利益。
• saaaaaam提到Law360的报道变得越来越晦涩难懂，可能与这些偏见检测工具有关，导致读者难以理解事件的真实情况。
• exiguus质疑媒体所谓的中立性，认为中立应基于证据而非避免使用某些词汇，并担心AI工具可能导致审查。
• wredcoll讽刺地指出，如果不喜欢真相，只需指责其有偏见并强迫其改变。
• jasonthorsness担心LLMs和ML算法在整个文章生命周期中的影响，认为小变化可能通过系统提示微妙地引导公众舆论。
• BrenBarn质疑偏见检测器的偏见由谁来检查，提出了对偏见检测工具本身的信任问题。
• MangoToupe认为新闻室的偏见实际上是其价值所在，透明地表达价值观比假装中立更值得信任。
• pkilgore反对自上而下强制使用特定工具的做法，认为如果工具好用，自然会得到采用。
• iFire担心AI“偏见”检测可能导致自动审查。
• croes引用经典问题“谁来看守看守者？”质疑偏见检测工具的监督机制。
• add-sub-mul-div认为“偏见”和“叙述”已经成为人们用来拒绝不喜欢观点的空洞词汇，并质疑中立立场的价值。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到AI工具对媒体内容的影响，以及对新闻中立性和偏见的不同理解。
• 对偏见检测工具的质疑和不信任是一个焦点，尤其是其可能导致的审查和自我审查问题。
• 透明度和价值观的表达被一些评论者视为比假装中立更重要的新闻价值。

data.title: Evidence of a 12,800-year-old shallow airburst depression in Louisiana
data.author: keepamovin
data.article_summary: 这篇文章报道了在路易斯安那州 Perkins 附近发现的一个疑似由低空宇宙空气爆发形成的地表凹陷。研究团队通过多种分析技术（如光学显微镜、电子显微镜、激光烧蚀等）对该地点的沉积物进行了研究，发现其中含有大量的冲击石英、微球粒、熔融玻璃等，这些都是与宇宙撞击事件相关的标志。放射性碳测年和氩-氩测年法显示，这些沉积物的年代大约在12,800年前，与新仙女木边界（YDB）时期相吻合。通过水码模拟，研究人员认为，一次低空空气爆发可能造成了这个300米长的浅凹陷及相关的地球化学特征。该研究表明，这一发现可能是北美首个被确认的YDB时期的空气爆发坑。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Younger Dryas撞击假说的可信性及其相关争议

不同观点：
• jonathaneunice认为自己没有相关专业知识，但指出Wikipedia页面内容非常戏剧化，对Younger Dryas事件及相关人员进行了激烈批评。
• tigereyeTO对North America在12,800年前可能受到撞击但未确认撞击点的假设表示兴趣，并提出是否与Younger Dryas撞击假说有关。
• protocolture持怀疑态度，认为Younger Dryas相关理论都是为了支持宗教原教旨主义和伪造历史，表示不信任。
• blueflow从地质学角度提出疑问，质疑沉积物和撞击坑的形状及形成机制，特别是玻璃球体的位置和撞击对湖泊的影响。
• slackfan以讽刺口吻提到Finno-Korean超战争的时间点，暗示对该讨论主题的调侃。
• MichaelZuo质疑假设的大型空中爆炸能否留下如此小的撞击坑，对物理可行性提出疑问。
• readthenotes1指出文章隐藏了重要信息，即“儿子声称父亲一直是对的”，质疑信息的呈现方式。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及对Wikipedia页面内容的可信性及偏见的批评（jonathaneunice, protocolture）。
• 地质学和物理学上的具体问题被提出，显示出对撞击假说细节的关注和质疑（blueflow, MichaelZuo）。
• 部分评论带有讽刺和调侃性质，显示出对该话题的怀疑和不信任态度（slackfan）。
• 信息的呈现和隐藏也被提及，反映出对媒体报道和科学讨论中潜在偏见的不满（readthenotes1）。

争议焦点：Younger Dryas撞击假说的科学依据及其相关证据的可靠性，特别是撞击事件是否发生、其影响以及相关研究是否受到偏见影响。

We report evidence of a likely low-altitude cosmic airburst near Perkins, Louisiana, associated with semi-consolidated deposits containing abundant shocked quartz grains, a classical impact indicator, along with spherules, meltglass, and microbreccia. Analytical techniques employed on these materials include optical microscopy, the universal stage, electron microscopy (SEM, TEM, and STEM), cathodoluminescence, laser ablation (LA-ICP-MS), neutron activation (INAA), and radiometric dating. These analyses reveal that the deposits exhibit morphological and compositional similarities to known impact-related proxies. Radiocarbon dating and 40Ar/39Ar analyses constrain the likely age of deposition to between 30,000 and 10,000 calibrated years BP, with a concentration of dates clustering around 12,800 years BP (12,835-12,735 cal BP), coinciding with the age range of the Younger Dryas Boundary (YDB). Spherule and meltglass abundances, along with evidence of high-temperature mineral transformations, are consistent with the effects of a high-energy airburst or impact. Hydrocode modeling suggests that a touch-down airburst could plausibly account for the observed shallow depression, material dispersal patterns, and geochemical signatures. Our study suggests that a 300-m-long lake/depression at the Perkins site represents North America’s first identified YDB-age airburst crater.
Introduction
Cosmic airbursts and impacts produce a wide range of surface effects, with high-altitude airbursts, such as the 1908 Tunguska event, primarily generating blast damage without forming craters [
1
]. In contrast, low-altitude “touch-down” airbursts may induce surface melting, spherule formation, shocked quartz, and shallow cratering [
2
]. Due to preservation challenges, few airburst signatures are documented in the geologic record, limiting our understanding of these events.

Figure 2

Figure 3

data.title: Couchers is officially out of beta
data.author: laurentlb
data.article_summary: Couchers平台正式推出1.0版本，脱离Beta阶段。此次更新包括一个新的策略，专注于构建安全、健康、活跃的沙发客社区，而不是贬低竞争对手。同时，推出了全新设计的首页，更清晰地传达平台的价值观和特色。新版本还增加了许多新功能，如重新设计的地图搜索、通知中心、以及改进的用户推荐系统，允许用户提交隐私反馈以增强安全性。此外，核心功能得到了优化，提升了整体用户体验。团队感谢多位成员的贡献，并希望通过这些改进吸引更多用户加入社区。

44446917.article_content:
A new chapter: Couchers is officially out of Beta!
Quick summary: we are out of Beta and into version 1, we're releasing a new strategy around safe & active community instead of bashing our competitors, a fancy redesigned landing page, and a bunch of new features to make core couch surfing functionality better! Share the platform with your friends and let's grow the community together!
We are super excited to share that Couchers is today finally out of the Beta phase with our version 1 (v1) launch. After five years of building and developing the platform and community―first through the Alpha stage and a very long Beta stage―we are finally ready for our big launch! This means a brand new strategy, a spiffy new landing page, and a bunch of new features.
Today we are launching
our new strategy centered around a commitment on being the safest, healthiest, and most active couch surfing community
. This is an evolution of our
original plan
, but adapted for the next stage of the community, where we clearly define what we stand for instead of living the shadow of another platform.
In addition, we are
launching a brand new landing page
to more clearly communicate our values and what sets us apart, and to explain what our community is all about to newbies and veteran couch surfers alike.
Finally, we have combined a
number of exciting new features
into this release. These have been gradually rolled out over the past few months to make sure they are ready for you today (and hopefully mostly free of bugs)! Read on to find out what these are.
What does the v1 launch mean?
Although the platform has been usable for a long time, until now, even some of the core functionality has been somewhat buggy and not as polished as we would like, in order to call it "complete". The v1 launch signals the completion of the platform in the sense that core functionality has been cleaned up and we believe it is fully ready for all to use! A lot of this cleanup effort was also done in the
v0.9.9 release a few months ago
.
This launch means we can now focus on growing the platform and coming up with new features that set us apart and help you connect with other members better.
New Features in v1
The features we decided to work on for v1 were picked to best further our goal of being a safe and active community, as well as tighten up the core functionality of the platform to make the experience super smooth and easy.
Redesigned Landing Page
We are really excited about our
new landing page
, which clearly communicates what Couchers is, what we stand for, and what you can find on the platform once you sign up. We hope this will help us gain more of the right kinds of members!
A huge thanks to
Nicole
who built the majority of the landing page;
Pablo
and
Aapeli
who also helped build it;
Marta
and
Charlotte
who designed it;
Jesse
and
Chris
who helped test it; and countless others who helped write or brainstorm our marketing message, or provided their input in other ways!
The new landing page features an anonymized map layer: pins are randomized to be at a random point 2-10 km (1.2-6.2 mi) away from their true location and are not tied to any user info. The map is further restricted to not zoom very far in.
References
We completely overhauled functionality for leaving a reference with two key updates:
you can now indicate whether you did not stay with or host someone (and we won't remind you to leave references); and
you can now send our Safety Team private feedback (that's not shown on the public reference) about your interactions through the reference flow. You can use this functionality to let us know if something felt off, even if there's no cause for bigger concern. More information is always better and helps the Safety Team understand situations better and keep the platform safe!
Thanks to
Aapeli
,
Nicole
, and
Jason
for these updates.
Nicole
also added the number of references to the references tab on profiles to draw more attention to it.
Find members faster: a new and redesigned map
Nicole
spent months re-architecting and rebuilding a brand new Map Search page! The old one was creaking with age and very difficult to update and add features to. Nicole rewrote it from scratch!
Aapeli
helped build some new backend functionality to significantly speed up searching, and
Jesse
among many others helped test it!
We put a lot of thought into making the map as usable as possible, trying to think about what should be shown, what should be hidden, and how to best display all this data. We hope you find it useful!
Don't miss out on news: new notification feed
We've been working on notifications for quite a few releases now. In this release we introduced a notification feed, rolled out push notifications for desktop and mobile, as well as added a bunch of new notification types for things like nested replies on discussions, and pending host requests.
Don't want so many notifications? No problem. Each notification type can be adjusted for a particular it

data.title: The Evolution of Caching Libraries in Go
data.author: maypok86
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了Go语言中缓存库的演变，特别关注于堆内缓存（on-heap）和堆外缓存（off-heap）的区别。堆外缓存能避免GC暂停并减少内存开销，但存在驱逐策略不佳、需转换数据类型等缺点，适合永久保存在内存中的数据。堆内缓存则解决了上述问题，但有一定GC开销。

早期Go缺乏高级并发缓存，常用方法是使用互斥锁保护的LRU/LFU缓存，并通过分片解决扩展问题，但实际效果有限。2019年，Dgraph实验室开发了Ristretto库，成为Go中领先的堆内缓存库，借鉴了Java中的Caffeine设计，使用BP-Wrapper和TinyLFU等技术提升性能。

Ristretto的优势在于高吞吐量和较好的命中率，但它引入的`MaxCost`和`cost`机制在v0.1.0版本中发生了破坏性变化，导致所有根据条目数量设定容量的用户出现问题，这一设计选择令人困惑。

44414630.article_content:
The Evolution of Caching Libraries in Go
¶
For the last few years, I've been developing caching library, and today I'd like to talk about the evolution of caches in Go and where we stand today. Especially since Go 1.24 was officially supposed to focus on caching improvements, but I haven't heard much news about them - time to fix that
.
On-heap VS Off-heap
¶
Before we begin, I believe it’s important to mention that in programming languages with GC (such as Go), caching libraries are divided into two main types: on-heap and off-heap. On-heap caches allocate memory in the heap, while off-heap caches allocate memory (for example) using mmap and then manage it manually.
Off-heap caches offer two primary benefits: they eliminate GC pauses regardless of entry count, and they maintain minimal memory overhead for metadata. These advantages, however, are offset by several limitations:
Poor eviction policy in most cases. Go off-heap caches often use something very similar to FIFO, which typically has a worse hit rate than LRU.
You have to convert your keys and values into strings/byte slices, as these are used as keys and values. This conversion will likely be much more expensive than any in-memory cache access operation.
Lack of many useful features, which we’ll discuss later.
Off-heap caches are typically useful when your cache must keep all data in memory permanently and rarely (if ever) evict entries. This becomes essential, for example, when your service's SLA depends on maintaining a hit rate consistently above 99.9%.
On-heap caches, in exchange for some GC overhead, solve all of the above drawbacks.
I should mention right away that in this article, we’ll only discuss on-heap caches, as they evolve independently of off-heap caches—and my knowledge of off-heap cache internals is relatively superficial. Just keep these differences in mind when choosing a cache.
Early development
¶
For a long time, Go lacked an advanced concurrent cache. All libraries essentially offered a mutex-protected map with LRU or LFU eviction. If you encountered scaling issues across CPU cores, the suggested solution was to shard the entire cache into multiple parts (lock striping). However, this approach comes with several problems:
While LRU and LFU exhibit non-optimal hit rates, implementing advanced eviction algorithms can yield substantial hit rate improvements. This matters because cache misses (necessitating expensive backend fetches) are typically orders of magnitude costlier than hits.
In reality, lock striping provides limited benefits because real-world workloads
follow Zipf-like distributions
. In Zipf distributions, the most frequent items occur exponentially more often than others. This means some stripes will experience high contention while others remain nearly idle.
Ristretto
¶
Ristretto
was developed by Dgraph Labs in 2019 to address a gap in Go's ecosystem. The library was exceptionally well-received by the community and effectively became the undisputed leader among on-heap caches in Go for years (and arguably remains dominant in some respects today).
During development, the Dgraph team drew inspiration from
Caffeine
, widely regarded as the best caching library in Java and arguably across all programming languages. They used the
BP-Wrapper
technique to mitigate contention and implemented
TinyLFU
(Count-Min Sketch) with Doorkeeper (Bloom filter) as their eviction policy to boost performance.
Now, let's examine Ristretto's advantages and disadvantages in detail.
Advantages:
Ristretto offers relatively high throughput, especially considering that when it was created, Go lacked synchronization primitives optimized for caching. For instance, Ristretto has to rely on sharded maps to achieve higher throughput.
Ristretto also delivers decent hit rates, though this claim comes with caveats we’ll discuss when covering its drawbacks.
Now, let’s begin the lengthy (unfortunately) discussion about Ristretto’s disadvantages.
Before Ristretto, Go caches always required specifying the cache capacity as the maximum number of entries. One of Ristretto’s innovations was introducing
MaxCost
and per-entry
cost
values. This allowed users to indicate that entries could vary in size, enabling the cache to account for it. Typically, this feature is used to approximate the cache size in bytes. If you instead want the cache capacity to equal the number of entries, you can simply set
cost=1
for every
Set
operation. Quite convenient, isn’t it? The core issue is that in Ristretto v0.1.0 (see
commit
), the
IgnoreInternalCost
option was introduced, and with it came a breaking change: Ristretto started automatically accounting for metadata byte size. This essentially broke
ALL
clients that specified cache capacity based on entry count. Why implement this change when they could have simply handled the byte overhead internally in Dgraph and Badger remains completely baffling to me. Ristretto's own
tests

本文讨论了Go语言中缓存库的演变，特别关注于堆内缓存（on-heap）和堆外缓存（off-heap）的区别。堆外缓存能避免GC暂停并减少内存开销，但存在驱逐策略不佳、需转换数据类型等缺点，适合永久保存在内存中的数据。堆内缓存则解决了上述问题，但有一定GC开销。

早期Go缺乏高级并发缓存，常用方法是使用互斥锁保护的LRU/LFU缓存，并通过分片解决扩展问题，但实际效果有限。2019年，Dgraph实验室开发了Ristretto库，成为Go中领先的堆内缓存库，借鉴了Java中的Caffeine设计，使用BP-Wrapper和TinyLFU等技术提升性能。

Ristretto的优势在于高吞吐量和较好的命中率，但它引入的`MaxCost`和`cost`机制在v0.1.0版本中发生了破坏性变化，导致所有根据条目数量设定容量的用户出现问题，这一设计选择令人困惑。

**总结**:  
XORSATFilter 是一个由美国国家安全局（NSA）发布的开源库，用于构建高效的集合成员资格过滤器（k-XORSAT 过滤器）。这些过滤器类似于布隆过滤器，但属于“静态”过滤器，即元素在构建后无法添加。其主要优势是内存使用接近最优，比布隆过滤器更节省空间，特别适合大数据集或需要大量分发的场景。该库依赖 pthreads 和标准 C 数学库，并使用 Git 子模块。使用时，先通过 `XORSATFilterBuilderAlloc` 分配构建器，添加元素后通过 `XORSATFilterBuilderFinalize` 生成查询器。查询速度在较高误报率下与布隆过滤器相当，较低误报率下更快。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：会员过滤器（membership filters）的效率及其应用，特别是关于SAT过滤器和Cuckoo过滤器的技术细节和局限性。

不同观点：
• inasio认为，会员过滤器（如Cuckoo过滤器）非常高效，能保证无假阴性（false negatives），但可能出现假阳性（false positives）。他指出，可以通过调整数据集和过滤器参数来控制假阳性的数量。他还提到，SAT求解器可以用于生成有效的解决方案，并引用了相关论文支持其观点。

• gopalv指出，SAT过滤器不支持增量构建（incremental building），这是Bloom过滤器在分布式数据库中的一个有趣特性。Bloom过滤器可以通过OR操作合并，而SAT过滤器可能需要手动迭代处理。不过，gopalv承认SAT过滤器在高精度和相同大小的情况下仍然非常有用。

• convolvatron提到，相关论文被付费墙阻挡，需要支付30美元才能访问。他提供了一个替代的免费论文链接，并指出该论文中的结构与完美哈希（perfect hashes）非常相似。

补充讨论：
• inasio引用的论文和技术细节是否易于获取是一个争议点，尤其是convolvatron指出的付费墙问题。
• gopalv对SAT过滤器和Bloom过滤器的比较揭示了不同过滤器在实际应用中的优缺点，特别是增量构建和合并操作的实用性。
• 讨论中涉及的技术细节，如假阳性控制、增量构建和过滤器结构的相似性，是理解这些过滤器应用的重要方面。

总体而言，讨论集中在会员过滤器的技术实现和应用场景上，特别是不同过滤器类型的优缺点和实际应用中的限制。

INTRODUCTION
This is a library for building and querying a compressed form of
set-membership filters, named k-XORSAT filters. These filters can be
used similar to how one would use a Bloom filter but with one
restriction --- items cannot be added after the filter is built. So,
this is an 'offline' or 'static' filter, whereas Bloom filters are
considered 'online' or 'dynamic'. The advantage is that k-XORSAT
filters achieve very near the optimal memory usage. That is, they use
much less memory than Bloom filters, making them desirable for either
large data sets (save space) or data sets that are provided to a large
user base (save bandwidth).
The advantage of k-XORSAT filters over other filters with small memory
footprint is that the near-optimal compression of k-XORSAT filters is
reliably achieved, and the query speed is comparable to Bloom filters
for high false positive rates, and faster than Bloom filters for small
false positive rates.
DEPENDENCIES
This package depends on pthreads and standard C math libraries.
This project also relies on a few git submodules. To get these
modules, clone the repository by doing either
git clone --recursive git@github.com:NationalSecurityAgency/XORSATFilter.git
or
git clone git@github.com:NationalSecurityAgency/XORSATFilter.git
cd XORSATFilter
git submodule update --init --recursive
INSTALL
Run
make
in the project root directory. The library file
libxorsatfilter.a
will (assuming successful compilation) be created
in this package's
lib
directory.
USE
k-XORSAT filters are built in two separate phases. The first step is
to add elements to a builder object. The second phase is to create a
querier object from a builder object. Once completed, the querier
object may be queried ad infinitum.
A builder is first allocated using
XORSATFilterBuilderAlloc
,
like so:
XORSATFilterBuilder *xsfb = XORSATFilterBuilderAlloc(0, 0);
Here, the first argument
0
is the number of expected elements the
filter will encode. It is safe to leave this number as
0
, but will
decrease calls to malloc if the number is given ahead of time. The
second argument is the number of bytes of metatdata to store with each
element. To use the data structure as a filter, enter 0. To use the
data structure as a dictionary, enter the number of bytes to store in
the dictionary.
Elements are added to the builder, like so:
XORSATFilterBuilderAddElement(xsfb, pElement, nElementBytes, pMetaData);
Here,
pElement
is a pointer to at least
nElementBytes
number of
bytes. This element will be copied into the builder.
pMetaData
is a
pointer to an array of bytes that will be stored into the data
structure and can be retrieved after construction. If the data
structure is used as a filter, this last argument may be
NULL
.
It is also possible to add the absence of an element to the
filter. This will cause the filter to return
False
when queried
against the element.
XORSATFilterBuilderAddAbsence(xsfb, pElement, nElementBytes);
After all elements have been stored, the querier is ready to be
created:
XORSATFilterQuerier *xsfq = XORSATFilterBuilderFinalize(xsfb, XORSATFilterFastParameters, nThreads);
The second argument is a structure consisting of four parameters: the
number of literals per row, the number of solutions, the number of
elements per block, and the desired efficiency of the filter. Three
samples are provided by the package,
XORSATFilterEfficientParameters
creates small filters but has longer
build time.
XORSATFilterPaperParameters
creates filters according to parameters used in a recent paper on XORSAT filters.
XORSATFilterFastParameters
creates filters quickly but
the filters are larger.
More information can be found near the tops of
include/xorsat_filter.h
and
src/xorsat_blocks.c
. Feel free to
define your own parameters to meet the needs of your application.
The third
nThreads
argument corresponds to the number of pthreads
used when building the querier. The returned querier (
xsfq
) will be
NULL
on error.
When finalizing, you will notice that the progress is printed to
stderr. These print statements can be turned off by commenting out the
following line in xorsat_fi

主要讨论点：Csmith工具及其相关技术在编译器测试中的应用和演变

不同观点：
• pfdietz认为Csmith是一篇广为人知且被广泛阅读的论文，激发了大量相关工作。他指出，通过随机生成正确程序来测试编译器的差异并不是这篇论文首创，对于C语言来说，生成代码时需要避免未定义行为，这是一个重大挑战。这篇论文的贡献在于如何生成多样化且行为明确的程序。

• pfdietz还提到了一篇2012年的后续论文，介绍了Creduce，这是一种可与Csmith一起使用的测试输入缩减工具。他认为Creduce不仅适用于C语言，还可用于其他语言。使用Creduce缩减输入时需要保持输入在C语言中的有效性并且避免未定义行为。

补充讨论：
• qualeed仅简单提及了Csmith论文的年份（2011），可能意在强调其历史背景或时间点，但未进一步展开讨论。

• 讨论中涉及的技术细节包括C语言中的未定义行为如何影响编译器测试，以及后续工具Creduce的引入及其跨语言应用的可能性。

争议焦点：
• 评论中并未出现直接的争议，但pfdietz对Csmith及其后续发展的技术性描述中隐含了对某些技术挑战的关注，特别是如何有效生成和缩减测试用例以确保其有效性。

data.author: gyomu
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了康奈尔大学图书馆的KMODDL（Kinematic Models for Design Digital Library）项目，该项目于2003-2005年开发，是一个开放获取的多媒体资源平台，旨在教授和学习运动学及机械历史与理论。KMODDL的核心是Reuleaux收藏，包含19世纪由机械运动学创始人Franz Reuleaux开发的200多个机械模型。这些模型通过静态和动态图像以及描述在康奈尔大学图书馆数字门户中提供在线访问。Reuleaux模型根据制造商Gustav Voigt的分类体系进行分类，涵盖各种机械元素类别。该项目最初属于国家科学数字图书馆，现已存档，可通过WayBack Machine Archive-It服务访问。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：专利模型和机械装置收藏的现状及保存问题

不同观点：
• [Animats] 对专利模型和机械装置的收藏有深厚感情，表达了对这些收藏品逐渐消失的担忧。他提到了几个曾经存在但现在已经不再展示的收藏，如美国专利局的专利模型收藏、史密森尼钟表擒纵机构模型收藏，以及芝加哥科学与工业博物馆的Borg-Warner机械联动展览。他认为这些收藏的消失是一种损失。

• [cbames89] 对这类机械装置收藏有个人情感，分享了自己在本科期间每次经过这些收藏都会尝试想出新的使用方法的经历。这表明他对这些模型有积极的个人体验，并认为它们具有启发性。

• [PaulHoule] 提到了KMODDL项目（一个关于动态设计和动态库的项目），指出其办公室的同事曾参与其中。他还提到，尽管经历了“数字图书馆衰退期”，许多模型今天仍然在Duffield和Upson大厅展出，其中一些设计独特的齿轮等装置仍然运转良好。这表明他对于这些模型当前的保存状态相对乐观。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点可能在于这些具有历史和教育意义的模型和收藏是否得到了应有的保护和展示。Animats和PaulHoule的观点在此形成对比，前者强调了许多重要收藏已经消失或不再展示，而后者则指出仍有一些模型在特定地点得到保存和展示。

• 这些讨论还揭示了公众对这些技术历史文物兴趣的变化，以及数字化时代对实体模型收藏的影响。

The Kinematics Models for Design Digital Library (KMODDL) was developed at Cornell University in 2003-2005 as an open access, multimedia resource for learning and teaching about kinematics – the geometry of pure motion – and the history and theory of machines. The core of KMODDL is the
Reuleaux Collection of Mechanisms and Machines
, an important collection of 19th-century machine elements held by Cornell University’s Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering. The Reuleaux Collection at Cornell University comprises more than 200 models developed by Franz Reuleaux (1829-1905), the founder of kinematics, for teaching and researching the principles of mechanical motion. The KMODDL Collection in the Cornell University Library Digital Portal provides online access to the Reuleaux Collection via still and moving images and descriptions of the models. Books and full-text documents related to KMODDL are located in the
eCommons
repository.
The original KMODDL digital resource was a collection in the National Science Digital Library, developed through a collaborative grant with the faculty of the Cornell University College of Engineering, the Cornell University Library, and several external partners. The original site has been archived and is made available via the
WayBack Machine Archive-It
service. (NOTE: not all resources or navigation are functional on this archived version of the KMODDL website.)
Further background on Kinematics, the Reuleaux Collection and the KMODDL project can be found under
About KMODDL
based on information written for the original site.
Browse the Collection
The
Reuleaux models
are classified according to the alphanumeric system employed in the catalog of the manufacturer, Gustav Voigt. The letter in a model's ID (e.g., D14 or S35) refers to a class of mechanism; the number is a specific instance of the class. This classification scheme is a simplified version of the taxonomy of machine elements elaborated in Reuleaux's work.

44430932.article_summary: 本文介绍了康奈尔大学图书馆的KMODDL（Kinematic Models for Design Digital Library）项目，该项目于2003-2005年开发，是一个开放获取的多媒体资源平台，旨在教授和学习运动学及机械历史与理论。KMODDL的核心是Reuleaux收藏，包含19世纪由机械运动学创始人Franz Reuleaux开发的200多个机械模型。这些模型通过静态和动态图像以及描述在康奈尔大学图书馆数字门户中提供在线访问。Reuleaux模型根据制造商Gustav Voigt的分类体系进行分类，涵盖各种机械元素类别。该项目最初属于国家科学数字图书馆，现已存档，可通过WayBack Machine Archive-It服务访问。

data.title: Evolution of Minimum Viable Product
data.author: johnxie
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了最小可行产品（MVP）的定义，并提出了一个改进版本。原定义描述MVP为满足基本使用要求的早期产品版本，可通过用户反馈进行改进。改进定义则强调产品应同时满足创作者和用户的基本使用需求。文章进一步指出，真正可行的产品要求创作者至少与用户一样频繁使用该产品，尤其在优秀软件中更是如此。作者以常用软件（如地图、音乐应用）为例，说明其创作者往往是活跃用户；而劣质软件（如反应迟钝的电子 kiosk 或医院系统）的创作者则可能很少使用自己的产品。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MVP（最小可行产品）的定义及其在产品开发和投资中的应用

不同观点：
• godelski认为，当前的投资环境存在问题，投资在基础演示之前就进行，甚至有些技术演示是伪造的。他强调演示应是实际展示而非仅是概念说明，并批评这种做法是不道德的。
• inerte提出MVP应被视为“最小学习产品”（MLP），重点在于通过最小发布来获取用户反馈和学习，而不是一味追求最低功能集。
• egypturnash通过实例批评了一些软件产品设计不佳，可能因为开发者并不使用这些产品，并感叹一些优秀产品因商业原因被淘汰。
• DantesKite将MVP比作科学实验，强调在资源有限的情况下高效测试假设，因为最终结果具有不确定性。
• daft_pink认为开发团队需要具备相关领域知识，以避免开发出不符合实际使用需求的产品。
• cadamsdotcom引入了“最低爱用产品”（MLP）的概念，通过iPhone的例子说明即使功能不全，只要某些方面表现出色也能赢得用户喜爱。
• themanmaran回应了egypturnash的观点，指出开发者不使用自己产品有时是现实限制，并举例说明尽管尽力打磨产品，但无法完全模拟真实用户环境。
• nico强调MVP应关注客户需求，并提出“最低可销售产品”（MSP）的概念，指出只要满足特定用户需求，即使是简单的产品形式（如电子表格）也具有价值。
• Sparkyte认为MVP不应演变为范围蔓延，重点在于快速吸引用户并从中学习以迭代产品。
• jasonthness同意产品由创作者使用或易于反馈的重要性，并指出这是成功迭代和增长的关键。
• esafak提出MVP的定义应关注功能的最小化和产品的竞争优势，认为产品相对竞争的独特性和价值决定其可行性。
• jbs789从中小企业创始人的角度出发，认为MVP应根据当前市场和客户反应进行调整，并指出客户期望随时间成熟。
• ozim通过对比不同用户对软件UX的反应，指出即便是最差的UX在某些情况下也能被用户接受和珍惜。

补充讨论：
• MVP的定义和标准在不同背景和行业中存在差异，反映出其应用的广泛性和复杂性。
• 投资与产品开发阶段的匹配问题，以及如何在早期有效验证产品概念，是讨论中的一个焦点。
• 产品开发团队的组成及其对产品使用环境的理解对产品成功至关重要。
• 争议焦点在于MVP的具体定义和实践方式，特别是在不同情境下的适用性。

44447429.article_content:
The Oxford dictionary definition of a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) is:
An early, basic version of a product (such as a piece of technology, a computer program, etc.) which meets the minimum necessary requirements for use but can be adapted and improved in the future, esp. after customer feedback;
Here's a proposed improved definition:
An early, basic version of a product (such as a piece of technology, a computer program, etc.) which meets the minimum necessary requirements for use
by its creators
and customers;
I think in practice, in order for a product to qualify as truly
viable
often requires the people who build it to use the product at least as much as any other person. This is especially true for great software. Think about the best software products you use every day: your favorite mobile maps application, favorite music app, or email client. It would be almost impossible to imagine that the people who build the products are not active users of the same apps!
Now think about a bad software product that you might encounter briefly or you are
forced
to use: a poorly designed electronic kiosk with 1000ms lag on every interaction, or a hospital electronic system. I think there's a high chance that the people building them rarely use them, or not at all.

data.title: WebAssembly Troubles part 4: Microwasm (2019)
data.author: Bogdanp
data.article_summary:
本文是关于WebAssembly问题及解决方案的四部分系列的最后一篇，提出了一个名为"Microwasm"的Wasm兼容格式。Microwasm旨在简化编译器和运行时的处理，同时保持WebAssembly的安全性和确定性。其主要目标包括：简化从编译器中间表示（IR）到Microwasm、从WebAssembly到Microwasm以及从Microwasm到原生代码的转换过程；最大化编译器和运行时之间的信息传递；优化流处理性能。

Microwasm的关键变化包括：取消局部变量，通过堆栈传递参数；采用CFG控制流，去除层次化块；去除块返回，改为通过跳转返回函数。此外，考虑将环境数据作为显式参数传递，以减少特殊情况处理并优化寄存器使用。

与传统WebAssembly相比，Microwasm简化了代码生成过程，使编译器后端实现更为简单，且不影响性能。这使得Microwasm在保持WebAssembly性能的同时，提供了更简便的编译和优化途径。

44411445.article_content:
WebAssembly Troubles part 4: Microwasm
Preamble
This is the final part of a 4-part miniseries on issues with WebAssembly and proposals to fix them.
Part 1 here
,
part 2 here
,
part 3 here
.
This article assumes some familiarity with virtual machines, compilers and WebAssembly, but I’ll try to link to relevant information where necessary so even if you’re not you can follow along.
Also, this series is going to come off as if I dislike WebAssembly. I love WebAssembly! I wrote a
whole article about how great it is
! In fact, I love it so much that I want it to be the best that it can be, and this series is me working through my complaints with the design in the hope that some or all of these issues can be addressed soon, while the ink is still somewhat wet on the specification.
Wasm is mostly a great spec, but it has some serious problems. I’ve detailed some of these issues in the previous three articles in this series, but it might seem like actually fixing these problems is untenable. Are you
really
going to deprecate locals? You’re going to deprecate
if
?
Well, turns out we don’t need to - we can get many of the desired benefits without dropping support for WebAssembly as it exists now.
Introducing Microwasm
Microwasm (working title) is Wasm-compatible format that can be efficiently consumed by runtimes and efficiently produced by compilers like LLVM. It’s currently implemented in the
Microwasm branch of Lightbeam
. The main goals are as follows:
It should be relatively easy to implement each of the following three steps:
Compiler IR->Microwasm;
Wasm->Microwasm;
Microwasm->Native.
It shouldn’t sacrifice any of WebAssembly’s guarantees on safety or determinism.
We should maximise the amount of useful information transferred from the compiler producing the Microwasm to the runtime consuming the Microwasm.
We should optimise for performance when consuming a stream of Microwasm, unless it conflicts with the performance goals of optimising compilers.
Converting Wasm to Microwasm must be possible to do in a streaming way, you shouldn’t need to block on loading a whole Wasm function before you’re able to produce Microwasm.
Wasm to Microwasm and then that Microwasm to native code should be precisely as performant as compiling the Wasm to native directly.
The last two points are the most important in my opinion. Basically what it means is that in the backends of
Wasmtime
we can just wrap the incoming Wasm stream in a streaming converter to Microwasm and consume that instead. This means our backends have the benefit of consuming a simpler language while not producing worse code. This means that while Wasm can enjoy the same performance that it already does, if a compiler wants to make use of Microwasm’s abiliy to allow improved performance then it can. Writing a Microwasm backend for most compilers would be much, much less costly than writing a Wasm backend and so it’s not like we have to convince compiler developers to maintain two equally huge backend codebases.
So how does it compare to WebAssembly? Well here’s a simple function from the Wasm specification tests:
(
module
(
func
(
param
i32
)
(
param
i32
)
(
result
i32
)
get_local
1
(
block
(
result
i32
)
get_local
0
get_local
0
br_if
0
unreachable
)
i32.add
)
)
Here’s that Wasm compiled to Microwasm:
.fn_0:
pick
0
pick
2
pick
3
br_if
.L1_end
,
.L2
.L2:
unreachable
.L1_end:
i32.add
br
.return
The immediate differences in the format as it exists now:
No locals - arguments are passed on the stack when entering a function and locals are emulated by adding
swap
and
pick
instructions. This essentially means that
set_local
,
get_local
and
tee_local
are a no-op at runtime, they only affect the virtual stack;
Only CFG control flow, no hierarchical blocks like Wasm - this was modelled on the
Funclets
proposal for Wasm;
No block returns - only calling new blocks. Returning from a function is
br .return
. This isn’t proper
continuation-passing style
, but it’s close enough that we get many of the simplicity benefits.
There’s another change that I’m considering where instructions that need data from the environment (for example, instructions that access the linear memory or the “table section”) have the environment passed in as an explicit argument. This reduces the special-casing in much of the translation code, but more importantly it allows us to free the register that this environment pointer would be stored in when we’re executing blocks that don’t need it. This would be a complex change to implement in the Wasm->Microwasm step though, so we’d want to work out for sure how it affects complexity and performance before making a firm decision either way.
The difference in quality of the generated code is immediately visible. Here’s Lightbeam’s assembly output for the function above before the implementation of Microwasm. I should say that the implementation of the backend that produced this is significantly more complex than the implementation using Microwasm:
push
rbp
mov

data.title: Tesla's energy storage business gets sucked into the company's downward spiral
data.author: rntn
data.article_summary: 特斯拉的能源存储业务曾是其亮点之一，但如今也出现下滑。数据显示，其Powerwall和Megapack产品的部署量连续两季度下降，今年二季度安装量为9.6吉瓦时，较一季度减少0.8吉瓦时。该部门在2024年四季度达到峰值，部署了11吉瓦时，全年共部署31.4吉瓦时。尽管此前该业务一直保持增长，从2020年的20亿美元收入增至去年的101亿美元，但今年的开局不利可能终结这一增长势头。与此同时，尽管整体市场在增长，但受关税和政策影响，未来增长可能放缓。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：特斯拉公司的经营状况、市场表现及其未来前景

不同观点：
• BSOhealth：认为特斯拉受到更多 scrutiny 是合理的，因为其市盈率高（PE 181），且销售逐年下降，但估值却达数万亿美元。这种不匹配使得特斯拉应受到更多关注和质疑。
• hermitcrab：批评马斯克的个人行为对特斯拉品牌的负面影响，包括与公众的对立、资源浪费在失败的Cybertruck项目上、与美国总统的对抗以及未兑现承诺，认为特斯拉前景不乐观。
• nico：对股市的非理性反应表示失望，特别是特斯拉在业绩不佳的情况下股价仍上涨，认为这是荒谬的。
• sokoloff：认为特斯拉在关税和供应链中断的情况下表现相对稳定，虽然目前销售下降，但未来可能会有更糟糕的季度。
• didip：批评特斯拉PowerWall产品的不兼容性问题，认为这是错误决策，影响了销售。
• Alupis：认为特斯拉“下行螺旋”的说法被夸大，主要是由反对其CEO政治立场的人推动的。大多数汽车公司也在经历销量下降，特斯拉的情况并非特别糟糕。
• blipvert：简单表达了对特斯拉和其领导层的负面态度。
• ProllyInfamous：通过拆解Tesla PowerWall Two发现其工程设计和安全性存在问题，不推荐该产品。

44447927.article_content:
Even Tesla’s energy storage business, which has been a small, yet notable bright spot, can’t escape the cloud that’s hanging over the company.
For the second consecutive quarter, deployments of its Powerwall and Megapack stationary storage products have declined, according to stats released by Tesla. In the second quarter of this year, the company installed
9.6 gigawatt-hours
of storage, down 0.8 gigawatt-hours from the first quarter.
Tesla’s energy storage division
peaked in the fourth quarter of 2024
, a three-month period that saw 11 gigawatt-hours deployed. In all, Tesla deployed 31.4 GWh of energy storage products in 2024.
Until this year, the sector has been a bright spot for Tesla, posting consistent year-over-year growth. Revenue from energy storage and solar installations grew from $2 billion in
2020
to $10.1 billion
last year
. Tesla’s poor start to the year suggests that streak is about to come to an end.
By contrast, the broader market for energy storage has been growing recently. Analysts at
Wood Mackenzie
said new installations hit a record high in Q1, the most recent period for which data is available, growing by 57% year-over-year.
Such growth is unlikely to continue, though, as tariffs on Chinese-made goods coincide with the ill-effects of a Trump-backed reconciliation bill currently being hashed out in Congress. There, Republicans have been working to eliminate key parts of the Inflation Reduction Act.
While battery storage installations might continue to receive tax credits under the bill, new restrictions over parts or materials sourced from foreign entities of concern (FEOC) could make any remaining tax credits nearly impossible to claim. The vast majority of minerals used in batteries are refined or processed in China.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大米中的砷含量及其对健康的影响

不同观点：
• [GeekyBear] 认为大米中的砷来源于过去在农田中使用的砷基农药，如对棉铃象鼻虫使用的农药，这些砷被水稻吸收。他引用了《Wired》杂志的一篇文章来支持这一观点。

• [jandrewrogers] 提出使用100 ppb的砷含量作为基线，并通过与硒的比较来推测每日大米摄入量（最多半公斤）应该是可以耐受的。他指出，由于缺乏人类数据，现有的模型多基于动物实验，因此这些推断具有不确定性。

• [Havoc] 质疑砷问题的重要性，认为如果这是一个严重问题，日本人作为大量消费大米的群体应该会受到影响，但事实并非如此。

• [aaroninsf] 引用了一篇文章，指出不同种类大米的砷含量不同，例如意大利Arborio大米和美国东南部的大米砷含量较高，而加州寿司米、泰国茉莉香米和印度香米砷含量较低。他还提到该研究未区分常规和有机产品，并引用了食品毒理学教授的意见来支持其观点。

补充讨论：
• [sleepyguy] 提供了一个存档链接，但没有进一步讨论，可能为其他讨论者提供了参考资料。

争议焦点：
• 大米中砷含量对人体健康的具体影响程度，尤其是日常摄入量是否在安全范围内。
• 不同地区和品种大米的砷含量差异及其对消费者的潜在风险。
• 动物实验数据是否足以推断人类对砷的耐受性。

data.title: Lorde's new CD is so transparent that stereos can't even read it
data.author: naves
data.article_summary: Lorde's new album "Virgin" was released on a transparent CD, intended to be eco-friendly and visually unique. However, fans have reported that the CD does not work on many players, including car stereos and older devices. The transparent disc, sold exclusively on Lorde's webstore, is currently unavailable due to being sold out. Many customers expressed disappointment, noting distortion and clipping in the audio files when they managed to rip the CD on a PC. Despite the aesthetic appeal, the functionality issues have frustrated fans who expected a working product. Lorde has not yet addressed these concerns.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：CD播放器的兼容性及其对老旧光盘的支持问题

不同观点：
• **vr46的观点**：现代CD播放器是老款机器的简化版，可能不支持一些老旧光盘的特性。他提到自己的Naim CD播放器就省略了去加重（de-emphasis）功能，而这一功能在14-bit时代的光盘中使用较多。他认为，考虑到CD介质设计的使用寿命可能超过人类寿命，应该完全向后兼容，以支持老光盘的播放。

• **leoh的观点**：leoh提出了一种简单的解决方案，认为可以通过在光盘上贴反光贴纸来尝试解决光盘无法被激光识别的问题。这个观点更侧重于通过外部手段解决技术问题，而非要求设备本身完全兼容所有老旧格式。

补充讨论：
• **争议的焦点**：主要在于现代CD播放器是否应完全向后兼容老旧光盘格式。vr46对现代设备省略某些老旧功能表示不满，认为CD作为一种长寿命的媒介，播放设备应确保对所有历史光盘格式的支持。而leoh则从实用角度提出简单的物理解决方案，而非要求设备层面的完全兼容。

• **重要论据**：
  - vr46以自己的Naim播放器为例，说明现代设备可能省略了去加重功能。
  - 他提到CD介质的设计寿命极长，因此设备应提供全面的向后兼容性。
  - leoh的建议是通过物理方法（如反光贴纸）来解决特定问题，而非要求技术规格上的完全支持。

44448387.article_content:
News
Lorde’s new CD is so transparent that stereos can’t even read it
﻿There’s only one version, and fans say it doesn’t work on most players.
﻿There’s only one version, and fans say it doesn’t work on most players.
by
Jess Weatherbed
Jul 2, 2025, 4:47 PM UTC
Link
Facebook
Threads
See this disc? Many CD players can’t.
Image: Lorde / Universal Music
Jess Weatherbed
is a news writer focused on creative industries, computing, and internet culture. Jess started her career at TechRadar, covering news and hardware reviews.
Lorde fans are clearly struggling to play the CD version of her new album. Customers who purchased the special edition of
Virgin
released on a transparent plastic disc are
reporting on Reddit
and
TikTok
that many CD players, car stereos, and other sound systems they’ve tried are unable to play it.
The transparent CD, promoted as being fully recyclable, is
currently sold out on Lorde’s webstore
and was the only disc variant available for the
Virgin
album. That may have been a welcome compromise for fans, given the singer
opted to forgo a CD release entirely
for her 2021 album
Solar Power
over waste and environmental concerns, but little comfort to customers who can’t purchase alternative options.
“Very cool looking (and I’m not going to return it), but doesn’t work in three of my players,”
said one Reddit user
. “PC was able to rip, but the files are not great (distortion and clipping).” User reports indicate that older hardware is less likely to work with the CD than devices with newer sensors.
One TikTok user demonstrated that her
car CD player was unable to recognize the disc
and said that forcing the CD inside resulted in automatic ejection, mirroring similar reports made in
Reddit comments
. “Whoever decided to design this is an idiot,” said elyxirtalkssmack. “Cars can’t read this CD, Walkmans can’t read this CD. You need to create CDs that are fit for purpose for the medium in which they are played on, which is older technology.”
Lorde has yet to address any of the issues raised about the transparent
Virgin
CD. The official cause of the playability issues also hasn’t been confirmed.
It’s certainly a striking disc. CDs with even partially clear designs are uncommon and can be a hit with collectors, but the lack of functionality in this example has been a bitter experience for some Lorde fans. “Seems like they didn’t account for this,”
one TikTok user said
. “Pretty disappointing. I know it was for an aesthetic, but at least press it on normal CDs too.”

Google Pixel 6a
Pixel 6a gets a mandatory Android update next week with battery reduction for some
Ben Schoon
| Jul 2 2025 - 11:40 am PT
0 Comments
Following
reports
of battery issues on Pixel 6a, Google has detailed a mandatory Android 16 update for these devices that, for some, will have a major impact on battery life. Here’s what the company is detailing for now.
Starting on July 8
, Google will roll out a new Android update, based on Android 16, to
all
Pixel 6a devices. The update is mandatory and
will be
installed automatically. For many Pixel 6a owners, there will be no changes in this update. For other “impacted” devices, Google will add a new, mandatory “battery management” change on Pixel 6a that will, for lack of a better word, have a major impact on battery life including both a reduction in battery life and in charging as well.
Google explains:
All Pixel 6a devices will receive a mandatory automatic software update to Android 16, with roll out starting July 8 2025,
but only Impacted Devices will receive the battery management features. Some users will see changes sooner than others, because the battery management features activate only after an Impacted Device reaches 400 charge cycles.
…Not all Pixel 6a devices are impacted by the reduction in battery capacity and charging performance. If your device is not impacted, your battery management features will remain the same as before, and you will not be eligible for these support options under this program.
The battery reduction takes place only once your Pixel 6a has reached 400 total battery cycles, a number that takes around 2 years (give or take) to reach for most users. For those who haven’t already reached this number, a reminder notification will be sent after the device reaches 375 cycles.

Given the impact this will have on affected devices, Google is offering remedies, just as it did with the
Pixel 4a’s battery reduction update
.
This includes a no-cost battery
replacement
either through in-person or mail-in repairs.
On a registration page
, Google also mentions a “cash payment” or Google Store “hardware discount credit” towards another Pixel phone.
As mentioned, the update starts rolling out on July 8, just under a week from today. If you’re still using a Pixel 6a, go check out Google’s
website
to see if your device is affected.
The update was
first announced in mid-June.

data.title: ICEBlock, an app for anonymously reporting ICE sightings, goes viral
data.author: exiguus
data.article_summary: ICEBlock是一款允许用户匿名报告美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）行踪的iPhone应用，近日在受到美国司法部长Pam Bondi的批评后迅速走红，成为美国App Store下载量最多的免费应用之一。该应用主要用户集中在洛杉矶，用户可以合法分享ICE sightings信息，并在ICE接近时收到通知。ICEBlock不收集或存储任何用户数据，确保匿名性。该应用的流行源于近期ICE突袭行动的增加以及公众的关注。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于报告警察活动的应用程序（ICEBlock）的合法性、隐私性以及其存在必要性的讨论。

不同观点：
• **普通公民的立场（neither_color）**：认为避免进入有警察活动的区域是为了避免不必要的麻烦，如DUI检查点或交通堵塞，而不是因为做了错事。同时，担心在非机场地点被要求出示证件和接受盘问，因此希望获得相关提醒。

• **对CNN报道的批评（abeppu）**：指出不仅报告警察活动被视为问题，甚至连讨论这种行为的文章也被视为问题。质疑如果讨论这类应用的文章获得大量关注，是否也被视为危害执法人员生命。

• **法律与自由的讨论（datax2）**：认为报告警察活动类似于通过其他方式（如闪灯）提醒其他司机有警察存在，属于言论自由的范畴，且已有法院裁定支持这种行为。

• **对政府官员点名私人公民的反应（beepbopboopp）**：认为安全部长和总检察长点名私人公民是不当行为。

• **对执法机构透明度的要求（jjwiseman）**：主张执法机构应具有更高透明度和问责制，包括公开无线电通信、面部识别数据库和车辆追踪信息，以平衡其与普通公民之间的权力不对等。

• **关于App Store政策的比较（callahad）**：提到苹果允许ICEBlock上架，而13年前曾因内容“令人反感”阻止了一款通知美国无人机袭击的应用上架，质疑苹果的政策一致性。

• **关于Android平台的隐私顾虑（ldoughty）**：指出开发者因隐私问题未在Android平台推出应用，担心处理政府传票时需要存储和处理信息。

• **对应用存在必要性的反思（csto12）**：认为在2025年的美国还需要此类应用是值得反思的。

• **对执法机构威胁的批评（mikestew）**：批评执法人员威胁应用开发者的言论，并表示因“ Streisand效应”将下载该应用。

• **国际对比（nottorp）**：提到伊朗有类似应用用于提醒宗教警察检查，暗示此类应用在不同国家的使用背景。

• **关于Android平台的技术问题（raver1975）**：质疑为何应用无法在Android上保持匿名性。

• **对应用形式的技术质疑（josefresco）**：质疑为何该应用不是以隐私优先的PWA（渐进式网络应用），并指出即使删除iOS应用，下载记录仍存在于云端和苹果服务器上。

• **对应用下架可能性的预测（_aavaa_）**：提到香港曾有类似警察追踪应用下架，预测ICEBlock可能也会因同样理由被下架。

补充讨论：
- **虚假报告问题（ramoz）**：提到该应用因对手战术的虚假报告而获得大量关注。
- **对资源分配的批评（wnevets）**：认为ICE浪费纳税人的钱，更希望资源用于飓风卫星数据。

44445646.article_content:
In Brief
Posted:
3:09 PM PDT · July 1, 2025
Image Credits:
Christopher Dilts / Bloomberg / Getty Images
Zack Whittaker
ICEBlock, an app for anonymously reporting ICE sightings, goes viral overnight after Bondi criticism
ICEBlock, an iPhone app that allows users to anonymously report sightings of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents, has rocketed to one of the coveted top spots in Apple’s U.S. App Store rankings. The upshot: Criticism from U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi
helped get it there
.
Most of ICEBlock’s users — about 20,000 — were in Los Angeles, where
ICE raids have become commonplace
over recent weeks,
according to CNN
. Following Bondi’s remarks late Monday, the app went viral overnight. As of Tuesday afternoon, the app is now one of the most downloaded free iPhone apps in the United States.
With ICEBlock, users can lawfully share information about where they have seen ICE within a 5-mile radius of their location. The app also sends notifications when ICE agents are sighted near the user’s location.
The app does not collect or store any user data, which TechCrunch confirmed by analyzing the app’s network traffic as part of a test.

data.title: Features of D That I Love
data.author: vips7L
data.article_summary:
这篇文章简要介绍了D编程语言的十个特性，特别适合初学者阅读。文章提到D语言的元编程非常强大，但未深入讨论。以下是十个特性的概要：

1. **自动构造函数**：如果定义了一个没有显式构造函数的结构体，编译器会自动生成一个。
2. **契约编程**：支持“in”断言验证参数，“out”断言验证返回值，以及“不变性”确保类型状态有效。
3. **美元符号操作符**：用于表示长度，简化数组操作。
4. **CTFE（编译时函数执行）**：允许在编译时运行大量D代码。
5. **内置单元测试**：方便进行代码测试。
6. **详尽的switch语句**：确保所有可能的情况都被处理。
7. **括号省略**：语法上允许省略某些括号。
8. **统一函数调用语法（UFCS）**：使函数调用更灵活。
9. **范围和选择性导入**：控制导入的范围和内容。
10. **内置文档生成器**：自动生成代码文档。

文章通过简单的代码示例展示了这些特性，旨在让读者轻松了解D语言的一些独特和实用功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：D语言的优缺点及其特性分析

不同观点：
• DLoupe认为D语言由于设计上的不足，无法替代C++。他指出D语言虽然有许多优秀特性，但学习细节时简单的事情会变得很复杂，例如函数参数类型繁多，条件编译可能导致代码难以理解。不过，DLoupe承认D标准库的源代码比C++的要好一些。

• elcritch赞赏D语言的统一函数调用语法（UFCS），认为这一特性可以减少对方法的依赖，结合泛型函数和概念，几乎不需要面向对象的支持。

• eric-p7对D语言未得到广泛应用表示不解，强调其快速编译、熟悉的语法以及支持多种编程范式。

• OskarS对D语言的"invariants"特性表示赞赏，认为它可以有效确保类型不变性，比C++26的合同特性更实用。

• Joker_vD解释了invariants的实际作用，指出它帮助揭示对象方法间调用时可能出现的问题，而不是制造新问题。

• Alifatisk喜欢D语言，但指出像int.init和$作为数组长度的缩写增加了心智负担。他也分享了使用D语言开发网站的积极体验。

• jadbox提出了D语言和Zig的比较问题，认为D语言的语法设计非常符合人体工学。
